name: VextJS greeting example
description: A manually declared greeting recipe verified against the published VextJS 2.0.0 API.

capabilities.name: Validated greeting endpoint
capabilities.description: Create POST /hello accepting a validated name and returning a greeting.
capabilities.whenToUse: The application needs this example's validated greeting recipe.

usage.instructions: Combine defineRoutes/app.post and validate.body as shown in routes/hello.ts. Graph resolution does not register the endpoint.
usage.input: A JSON body with a name containing 1–30 characters.

capabilities.name: POST route declaration
capabilities.description: Use defineRoutes and app.post(path, options, handler) to declare an HTTP POST route.

usage.instructions: Import defineRoutes from vextjs. Register app.post('/hello', options, async (req, res) => { ... }) in its callback.

capabilities.name: Body validation
capabilities.description: Declare validate.body with schema-dsl strings and read validated values using req.valid('body').

usage.instructions: Set options.validate.body to { name: 'string:1-30' }, then use req.valid('body').name in the handler.
